career_ladder.note: Officers in the Finance Function at Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL) are inducted into the executive cadre in Grade A and advance through structured promotions governed by IOCL Officer Cadre Promotion Policy.

steps.source_label: IOCL Recruitment of Officers in Finance Function Notification
IOCL Promotion Policy (Grade B to C)
IOCL Board & Corporate Finance Leadership Rules

exam_scheme.note: Selection consists of shortlisting based on CA/CMA examination merit or UGC-NET/written evaluation followed by Group Discussion (GD), Group Task (GT), and Personal Interview (PI).

stages.stage_name: Stage 1: Shortlisting on CA/CMA Merit / Written Test
stages.source_label: IOCL Selection Methodology for Finance Function

papers.paper_name: Shortlisting Evaluation (Marks in CA/CMA Final Examination)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Passing both groups of CA/CMA with merit ranking

financial_package.note: Finance Officers enter in Grade A with basic pay ₹50,000. Compensation includes 58% IDA constant as of 2025-07-01, HRA (up to 27%), cafeteria perks (35%), and annual Performance Related Pay (PRP). Total CTC is approximately ₹14–16 Lakhs per annum.
financial_package.pay_source_label: IOCL Compensation & Benefits for Officers in Finance Function
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated with Basic Pay ₹50,000, 58% IDA (₹29,000), HRA (up to 27% = ₹13,500), and Cafeteria Perks @ 35% (₹17,500), less statutory deductions for PF and Tax.
official_perks: Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) indexed to AICPI
Company accommodation / leased housing or HRA up to 27%
Cafeteria perks up to 35% of basic pay
Comprehensive medical insurance and treatment at IOCL designated hospitals
Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, and Superannuation Benefit Fund
